rationale: The identical environmental-universe x selection-strategy method must be selected in at least two thirds of the 15 predeclared full reruns; M remains a sensitivity axis rather than an optimized component.
With 5 seeds x 3 sealed fractions the same universe x strategy method must be selected in at least 10 of 15 independently rebuilt runs.

Within every selected-method stability run the method must individually lead in at least two of the three predeclared 150/300/500 km M sensitivity specifications; a win produced only by cross-M rank averaging is insufficient.
Require at least a one-percentage-point mean unseen-taxon presence-rank advantage over each non-self strategy comparator in matched taxon x M comparisons rather than promoting on numerical ties.
At least two thirds of matched unseen-taxon x M paired comparisons must favor the selected strategy over each non-self comparator.
Require a substantial matched unseen-taxon evidence base across repeated runs and M sensitivity specifications.
Whichever strategy is selected is self-not-applicable; the other two predeclared strategies must satisfy the evidence thresholds.
